title: Oliver's mute work, derby and two-trumpet breaks
summary: He describes Oliver's talking mute and hand derby, and how Oliver and Armstrong played their breaks together.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends
